title: Telephony Call Routed Event
description: The call was handed somewhere: answered by the voicemail app, forwarded to another number, bridged to a SIP device, or given to an IVR or voice agent. ordering_key is call:<call_id>. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (telephony).

call_id.description: Provider call identifier (Telnyx call_control_id or TeXML CallSid). Every event of one call carries the same value; ordering_key is call:<call_id>.

line.description: The operator line involved: 'cell' (the personal Verizon line, forwarded from the Android phone), 'imessage' (the operator's iMessage account on the Mac, through BlueBubbles), or the E.164 of a Telnyx number.

target.description: Destination number, SIP URI, application or agent name.
